{{Quote|Ya think ya can handle more Black Sun thugs? So go and make us Car'das proud, yah?|[[Aleas Rans'ery]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:BSA" />}}
The '''Battle of Tansarii Point Station''' was a space battle between the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] forces taking place near [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] near [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Thanks to the efforts of newly recruited spacers, the Car'das successfully repelled the Black Sun pirates who threatened the system.

==Background==
{{Quote|Be careful out there, the Black Sun are everywhere lately.|[[Serissu]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization had taken interest in the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] and deployed both ground and space-based agents in and around the station. The ground-based agents were a team of hackers, who were eventually defeated by agents working for [[Loche Crestingsky]] and the Car'das.<ref name="SWG:StS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Stopping the Slicers|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> In the space around the station, Black Sun had stationed several starfighters who committed acts of piracy against several traders in the region,<ref name="SWG:PfBS" /> among others [[Dynath Miners]].<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] trainer [[Serissu]] started to recruit spacers to become pilots for Car'das. She provided them [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and taught them basic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] piloting skills.<ref name="SWG:Fpm" /> The pilots quickly proven great capabilities and succeed in several missions.<ref name="SWG:Fpm" /><ref name="SWG:PfBS" /><ref name="SWG:E" /> However, Serissu and her pilots discovered that [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] pirates had become more aggressive and seriously threatened Tansarii Point Station.<ref name="SWG:E" /> A number of operations were thus conducted under the supervision of [[Laetin A'shera]], [[Aleas Rans'ery]], and [[Dartas Pytin]] against the Black Sun in an effort to stop them from terrorizing the star system. Not willing to helplessly watch the attack on the station, the spacers, who were in the station, having returned from a mission against the Black Sun, jumped into a starfighter and joined the Car'das fighters in the battle against the criminal organization.<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /><ref name="SWG:PBJR" /><ref name="SWG:PM" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I don't have time to argue with you, kid. We're losing pilots left and right! Even if you're fodder, I suppose that'll do. Fine, you're in.|[[Dartas Pytin]], to a Car'das pilot|<ref name="SWG:PM" />}}
[[File:Talonbane_Cobra_dogfight.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Car'das pilot engages [[Talonbane Cobra/Legends|Talonbane Cobra]].]]
The battle really started when Black Sun starfighters attacked the [[Lucent Ivaya]] quadrant of the Bright Jewel system, home of the Tansarii Point Station and of the Dynathian [[H-5 70 Mining Facility]]. Black Sun spies infiltrated Dynathian [[Unidentified transport class|mining transports]]<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /> while Black Sun starfighters attacked Dynath transports in the [[Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt]].<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" /> Car'das pilots dispatched by Laetin A'shera intercepted the spies and repelled the pirates.<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /><ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" /> Information found on a Black Sun spy was quickly transmitted to Agent [[Rayar]] of the Car'das intelligence ring.<ref name="SWG:SfBS" /> Later, during a mission to warn the Car'das allies about Black Sun activity, the Car'das M3-A Scyk fighters were infected by the [[Black Envy]], a Black Sun [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]].<ref name="SWG:WtA" /> Laetin A'shera and his pilots decided to use it to their advantage and finally trapped the Black Sun assassin [[Talonbane Cobra/Legends|Talonbane Cobra]] in the [[Lurid Aurora Nebula]]. The Car'das Scyk fighters were later freed of the Black Envy.<ref name="SWG:AtA" /> Dartas Pytin eventually tasked his pilots to hunt down Black Sun spies in the system in order to prevent the spread of the Black Envy virus.<ref name="SWG:PM" />

[[File:Kallor_brothers_rescue.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Two Car'das Scyk fighters defend the Kallor brothers.]]
In the meantime, Aleas Rans'ery commanded Car'das pilots patrolling in the [[Bright Jewel Ribbon]] quadrant.<ref name="SWG:PBJR" /> She tasked the [[Sulale Kallor|Sulale]] and [[Waris Kallor]] to scout enemy territory and find weaknesses in the Black Sun bases. The Kallor brothers succeed in their mission but were attacked by Black Sun starfighters. Waris Kallor's ship was captured while Sulale managed to hyperspace out the area. Waris was finally rescued by Car'das starfighters dispatched by Rans'ery and returned to Tansarii Point Station. Car'das pilots then headed to Sulale Kallor's damaged ship and defended the [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95]] while Sulale performed repairs. Sulale Kallor finally returned to the [[Nova Orion Station]].<ref name="SWG:KBR" /> Rans'ery's pilots later rescued [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] [[Atris (officer)|Atris]] of the Dynath Miners from Black Sun attacks in the Bright Jewel Ribbon.<ref name="SWG:BSA" /> Aleas Rans'ery eventually tasked her pilots to eliminate the [[Ace/Legends|ace]] and Black Sun hero [[Arlem Demonhunter]] in a counterattack.<ref name="SWG:CA" />

[[File:Bright_Jewel_Ribbon_dogfight.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Car'das and Black Sun starfighters dogfighting in the Bright Jewel Ribbon.]]
With the help of the spacers, who shot down many Black Sun starfighters, the Car'das managed to repel the attack. Seizing the opportune moment, Dartas Pytin decided to have his forces strike against the Black Sun in a series of attacks on nearby Black Sun bases of operation, the [[Salient Trinity]], in the Black Sun-controlled [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrant. He first ordered his pilots to attack the [[Dual Moons]], eliminate Black Sun pilots and kill [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commanders]] [[Chaen]] and [[Ondara]].<ref name="SWG:AtT" /> Dartas Pytin's pilots finally assaulted the [[Darkveil Eclipse]], the main Black Sun hub, and his defenses led by Lieutenant Commander [[Rilis]]. The Car'das wing, still including the spacers, finally joined other Car'das pilots to eliminate remaining Black Sun forces and were successful in eliminating large portions of the Black Sun forces in the system. Black Sun commanders were all killed during the fighting.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Ah ha! The hero of the day! You were great out there! You ensured our victory against the Black Sun.|[[Dartas Pytin]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:DE" />}}
Largely thanks to the heroic deeds of the spacers, the Car'das emerged victorious, having removed the Black Sun threat from the Bright Jewel system for the time being. The spacers were awarded a decoration, "''Hero of Tansarii Point Station''", for the participation in the battle.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Tansarii Point Station appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TPS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Battle of Tansarii Point Station was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:TPS" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

The battle did not have a proper name in the game<ref name="SWG:TPS" /> and the event was conjecturally dubbed "Battle of Tansarii Point Station" when the [[Wookieepedia]] article was created in [[2007]].<ref>[[w:c:starwars:Battle_of_Tansarii_Point_Station/Legends?offset=&limit=500&action=history|History: Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends]]</ref> This name was later used by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] that eventually [[canon]]ized the Wookieepedia article title in a card of the ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]''.<ref name="Card-FFGXW-Tansarii Point Veteran">{{FFGXW|set=M3-A Interceptor Expansion Pack|cardname=Tansarii Point Veteran}}</ref>
